breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) on the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by removing the Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly ignored the contradictory Dirichlet condition and only implemented the Neumann conditions, thus matching the ground truth's resolution.
